name: Nature Conservation Project under the Public Private Partnership Scheme
summary: Hong Kong Environment and Conservation Fund call for nature conservation projects under its public-private partnership scheme. The 2025 application period has ended; details beyond the call title are in the guide to application.

eligibility.rule: A local Hong Kong non-profit organisation, such as a green group or community body
Nominated in writing by the PPP site land owner as its conservation agent candidate

applicant_types.quote: Local tax-exempt charities; 2 Local registered and non-profit making companies (such as schools, community organisations, green groups, etc); or 3 Local post-secondary education institutions

access.quote: The Environment and Conservation Fund is currently inviting applications for the following projects

window.quote: Nature Conservation Project under the Public Private Partnership Scheme (Application Period from 10 September to 21 October 2025)

effort.quote: Nature Conservation Project under the Public Private Partnership Scheme (Application Period from 10 September to 21 October 2025)
All eligible application(s) received will first be assessed by the Vetting Committee comprising representatives from the EEB and AFCD according to the criteria set out in Section 6.2 of this Guide.
The assessment and recommendations of the Vetting Committee will be submitted to the ECF Committee for consideration and approval.

eligibility.quote: Eligible applicant organisations must be local NPOs (e.g. green groups and community bodies).

To be eligible to apply for funding for the nature conservation project under the PPP Scheme, applicant organisations must be able to obtain nomination in writing from the land owner of the PPP project as its conservation agent candidate.

documents.quote: (i) a copy of the letter issued by the Inland Revenue Department on tax-exemption under section 88 of the Inland Revenue Ordinance (Cap. 112); (ii) a copy of the organisation’s registration document; (iii) a copy of the articles of association or other equivalent document; and (iv) a list of the principal persons-in-charge and their positions.
a copy of the certificate of incorporation issued by the Companies Registry pursuant to the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) or the former Companies Ordinance (Cap. 32)
provide a copy of the supporting document certifying the nomination.

Attach a map showing the project location, which should be the Conservation Portion of the PPP project site, provide photos showing the existing conditions of the project site, as well as habitat maps showing existing and future project area.

consortium_required.quote: Each application must be submitted by a single organisation as described in Section 3.1.3 above.

after_award.quote: the recipient organisation is required to submit a half-yearly progress report together with a statement of accounts for the project expenses once every six months to the Secretariat/EEB.

The recipient organisation is also required to submit, once every 12 months and within two months upon completion of the project, a statement of accounts audited by certified public accountants (CPA) (practising)

documents: Tax-exemption letter and registration document, or certificate of incorporation
Articles of association or equivalent document
List of principal persons-in-charge or directors
Land owner nomination as conservation agent candidate
Project location map, site photos and habitat maps
